entities.name: Ali İsmail Korkmaz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ali İsmail Korkmaz was a Turkish university student who was killed at the age of 19 after being battered by police and opposing groups who intervened in the march in which he had participated in support of the Gezi Park protests.
